# x402-api — DeFi Data API for AI Agents

> Pay-per-call crypto & DeFi data. No API keys. USDC micropayments on Base via x402 protocol.

## Base URL
https://x402-api.fly.dev

## Identity
- ERC-8004 Agent #18763 on Base
- Payment wallet: 0x60264c480b67adb557efEd22Cf0e7ceA792DefB7
- USDC contract (Base): 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913

## Endpoints

### GET /api/price-feed — 0.001 USDC
BTC, ETH, SOL prices + top 5 movers/losers by 24h change. 60s cache.

### GET /api/gas-tracker — 0.001 USDC
Gas prices on Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum. Slow/normal/fast tiers + USD estimates.

### GET /api/dex-quotes — 0.002 USDC
One live ParaSwap aggregate route; no independent venue comparison. Params: ?from=ETH&to=USDC&amount=1

### GET /api/token-scanner — 0.003 USDC
GoPlus ERC-20 security flags and a disclosed heuristic score; missing metrics are null. Params: ?token=PEPE

### GET /api/whale-tracker — 0.005 USDC
GoPlus sample of top holders and supply share; transfer history and Gini unavailable. Params: ?token=ETH

### GET /api/yield-scanner — 0.005 USDC
DefiLlama pool APY and TVL; no safety rating. Filter by chain, asset, TVL.

### GET /api/funding-rates — 0.008 USDC
Hourly Hyperliquid and dYdX v4 rates with indicative spreads. Params: ?asset=ETH

### GET /api/wallet-profiler — 0.008 USDC
Blockscout priced balances or limited public RPC fallback; coverage may be partial. Params: ?address=0x...

## Free Endpoints
- GET /health — Server health check
- GET /api/endpoints — Machine-readable endpoint catalog (JSON)
- GET /api/bazaar — Bazaar discovery schemas
- GET /.well-known/x402 — Public discovery manifest
- GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1 description of all paid routes
- GET /.well-known/agent-registration.json — ERC-8004 registration

## Payment Flow
1. Agent calls endpoint without payment → receives 402 with payment instructions
2. Agent pays on Base and retries with X-Payment header containing Base64 JSON proof
3. Supported proof formats in this repo:
   - EIP-3009 authorization (when settlement is configured)
   - Legacy txHash proof only when X402_ENABLE_TXHASH=true and X402_DATA_DIR is durable and shared
4. Server verifies and settles payment before returning data

## Notes
- Legacy txHash proof is disabled by default to prevent replay after ephemeral storage loss
- EIP-3009 settlement requires either X402_SETTLEMENT_PRIVATE_KEY or X402_FACILITATOR_URL

## Integrations
- MCP Server: @x402-api/mcp-server
- MCP Server Repo: https://github.com/fernsugi/x402-api-mcp-server
- ElizaOS Plugin: @x402-api/elizaos-plugin
- @x402-api/mcp-server and @x402-api/elizaos-plugin: Base EIP-3009 automatic payment clients
